function.name: video_games_get_player_count
function.description: Retrieves the number of active players for a specified video game and year. Unlike video_games_get_sales, which retrieves the sales figures, this retrieves the number of active players.

game_title.description: The title of the video game.

function.name: video_games_get_sales
function.description: Retrieves the sales figures for a specified video game and year. Unlike video_games_get_player_count, which retrieves the number of active players, this retrieves the sales figures.

game_title.description: The title of the video game.
